# Katharine Wolanyk writes for IAM about trends in corporate IP monetization


- Patent & IP


August 6, 2024


-
-
-
-


[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) writes for IAM about trends in corporate IP monetization.


Wolanyk writes: "For many patent owners, financed divestitures may be the optimal option. for little-to-no risk, with minimal operational burden, companies can reduce cost and generate new revenues by leveraging their IP assets."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.iam-media.com/article/three-case-studies-illustrate-growing-corporate-ip-monetisation-trend)
